Test Case Description: Verify default/reset value of register gp0_gpio_8 after reset. Read the register and compare against expected default value masked with read_mask. The data_in bit (bit 0) is masked off using (data_rd & 0xfffffffe) before comparison.
Register Field Name: data_in(0:RO:0); intr_raw_sts(1:RO:0); intr_clr(16:WO:0); pedge_intr_en(17:RW:0); nedge_intr_en(18:RW:0); level_sel(19:RW:0); io_ctrl(20:RW2:1); dout(21:RW2:0)
Register Description: GPIO pin level/interrupt control register for GPIO_8. Fields: data_in (pin level readback); intr_raw_sts (interrupt raw status); intr_clr (write-1-to-clear interrupt); pedge_intr_en (pos-edge interrupt enable); nedge_intr_en (neg-edge interrupt enable); level_sel (level interrupt select); io_ctrl (input/output mode); dout (output data).
Test Methodology: Read register after reset and compare with default value array. Mask read data with 0xFFFFFFFE to exclude data_in bit 0. Compare (data_rd & 0xFFFFFFFE) == default_value_array[i].
Preconditions: System reset applied; GPIO0 instance selected (#define GPIO0 1); no prior register writes.
Test Steps:
1. Apply system reset.
2. Read register at MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8.
3. Mask read value: data = (data_rd & 0xFFFFFFFE).
4. Compare data with GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8_DEFAULT_VAL.
Expected Result: Read value (masked) matches GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8_DEFAULT_VAL (expected: 0x00100000 based on io_ctrl reset=1 at bit 20).
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if masked read value == default_value_array entry; FAIL with mismatch log otherwise.
Notes: skip_rst_array[0]=0 so this register is NOT skipped for default check.

Register Description: Write-Read test with pattern 0xFFFFFFFF on RW/RW2 fields. RO fields (data_in bit 0; intr_raw_sts bit 1) are not writable. WO field (intr_clr bit 16) is write-only and not readable.
Test Methodology: For each register: write (pattern & write_mask_array[i]); then read back (read_reg & read_mask_array[i]); compute expected = ((pattern & read_mask & write_mask) | (~write_mask & read_mask & default_value)); compare.
Preconditions: System reset applied; skip_array checked (registers with skip_array[i]==1 are skipped); write_mask != 0.
Test Steps:
1. Set data_wr = 0xFFFFFFFF.
2. For each register (i=0..2): if skip_array[i]==0 and write_mask!=0 then write_reg(addr data_wr & write_mask).
3. For each register: read_reg(addr) & read_mask.
4. Compute expected value.
5. Compare read vs expected.
Expected Result: Read-back value matches computed expected value for each register.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if all read values match expected; FAIL with address and mismatch details logged.
Notes: Pattern 1 of 6. Skipped registers: skip_array[32]=1 (gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 at 0x80 is VRRW type skipped for wr/rd).

Test Case Description: Test level-select interrupt with active-high configuration (level_sel=1) for all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 to GPIO_39). For each pin: set io_ctrl=1 (input mode) and level_sel=1 (bit 19); enable group interrupt; trigger via SRAM write; verify interrupt fires in ISR.
Register Name: gp0_gpio_8 (base; computed as MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4 for i=0..31)
Register Description: Per-pin GPIO register used for level-select interrupt configuration. Write 0x00180000 sets io_ctrl=1 (input mode) and level_sel=1 (active-high level interrupt). For each of 32 pins the test iterates i=0..31 using address MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (i*4).
Test Type: Interrupt Functional Test - Active High Level
Test Methodology: For each GPIO pin i (0-31): 1) Write 0x00180000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) to set input mode + level_sel=1. 2) Enable group interrupt bit i in gp0_intr1_intr_en1. 3) Write 0xFFFFFFFF to SRAM (0xA0243ffc) to trigger pin high. 4) Wait for ISR. 5) In ISR: verify intr_raw_sts (bit 1) is set; verify group status bit i in gp0_intr1_intr_sts1; clear interrupt by writing 0x00110000; verify cleared; disable group interrupt; clear sysreg raw_stcr1.
Preconditions: System reset applied; GPIO0 instance (#define GPIO0 1); GIC IRQ 87 enabled; sysreg intr_en1 gpio0_intr bit enabled.
Test Steps:
1. Enable GIC IRQ 87.
2. Write MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 = LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR.
3. Loop i=0 to 31:
  a. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) 0x00180000)
  b. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 1<<i)
  c. write_reg(0xA0243ffc 0xFFFFFFFF)
  d. Wait for ISR (int_pend loop)
4. In ISR:
  a. Read MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) check bit 1 (intr_raw_sts)
  b. Read MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1 check bit i
  c. Write 0x00110000 to clear interrupt
  d. Verify cleared (expect 0x100001)
  e. Disable group interrupt (write 0x0 to INTR_EN1)
  f. Verify group status == 0
  g. Clear sysreg raw_stcr1
  h. Clear GIC IRQ
Expected Result: For each pin: intr_raw_sts bit set; group interrupt status bit i set; interrupt clears successfully; group status returns to 0; sysreg status cleared.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if all 32 pins pass all checks (intr_raw_sts clear interrupt group_sts sysreg_clear); FAIL if any test_err incremented.
Coverage Area: Interrupt Functional - Level Select Active High
Notes: Active-high level interrupt: level_sel=1 means interrupt generated when pin is at level 1. SRAM write at 0xA0243ffc drives pin high.

Test Case Description: Test level-select interrupt with active-low configuration (level_sel=0) for all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 to GPIO_39). For each pin: set io_ctrl=1 (input mode) and level_sel=0 (bit 19=0); enable group interrupt; trigger via SRAM write with inverted pattern; verify interrupt fires in ISR.
Register Name: gp0_gpio_8 (base; computed as MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + i*4 for i=0..31)
Register Description: Per-pin GPIO register used for level-select interrupt configuration. Write 0x00100000 sets io_ctrl=1 (input mode) and level_sel=0 (active-low level interrupt). For each of 32 pins the test iterates i=0..31.
Test Type: Interrupt Functional Test - Active Low Level
Test Methodology: For each GPIO pin i (0-31): 1) Write 0x00100000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) to set input mode + level_sel=0. 2) Enable group interrupt bit i. 3) Write ~(1<<i) to SRAM to drive pin low. 4) Wait for ISR. 5) In ISR: same verification as active-high test.
Preconditions: System reset applied; GPIO0 instance; GIC IRQ 87 enabled; sysreg intr_en1 gpio0_intr bit enabled.
Test Steps:
1. Loop i=0 to 31:
  a. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) 0x00100000)
  b. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 1<<i)
  c. write_reg(0xA0243ffc ~(1<<i))
  d. Wait for ISR
4. ISR verification same as active-high test.
Expected Result: For each pin: interrupt fires on low level; all ISR checks pass.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if all 32 pins pass; FAIL if any test_err incremented.
Coverage Area: Interrupt Functional - Level Select Active Low
Notes: Active-low level interrupt: level_sel=0 means interrupt generated when pin is at level 0. SRAM write ~(1<<i) drives specific pin low.

Test Case Description: Verify GPIO group interrupt enable register (gp0_intr1_intr_en1) correctly enables/disables per-pin interrupt masking. Each bit corresponds to one GPIO pin (bit 0=GPIO_8 through bit 31=GPIO_39).
Register Description: Group interrupt enable register. Each bit enables the corresponding GPIO pin's interrupt to propagate to the group interrupt output. Writing 1<<i enables GPIO_(8+i) interrupt; writing 0x0 disables all.
Test Methodology: For each pin i: write (1<<i) to enable only that pin's interrupt; verify interrupt fires for that pin only; then write 0x00000000 to disable all; verify group status returns to 0.
Preconditions: System reset applied; GPIO0 instance; per-pin interrupt configured.
Test Steps:
1. For each i=0..31: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 1<<i).
2. Trigger interrupt for pin i.
3. Verify group interrupt fires.
4. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 0x00000000).
5. Read MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1 and verify == 0.
Expected Result: Each pin's interrupt is individually controllable; disabling all clears group status.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if enable/disable works correctly for all 32 pins; FAIL otherwise.
Notes: All 32 bits are RW with reset value 0.

Test Case Description: Verify GPIO group interrupt status register (gp0_intr1_intr_sts1) correctly reflects masked interrupt status for each GPIO pin. This is a read-only register.
Register Description: Group interrupt masked status register. Each bit reflects the masked interrupt status of the corresponding GPIO pin. Read-only; set by hardware when interrupt is enabled and raw status is active.
Test Methodology: In ISR: read gp0_intr1_intr_sts1 and verify bit i is set when GPIO_(8+i) interrupt is active and enabled. After clearing interrupt and disabling enable verify status returns to 0.
Preconditions: Interrupt triggered for specific pin; group enable bit set.
Test Steps:
1. In ISR: rdata_grp = read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1).
2. Verify (rdata_grp & (1<<i)) != 0.
3. After clearing interrupt and disabling enable: verify rdata_grp == 0.
Expected Result: Status bit i is set when pin i interrupt is active and enabled; clears to 0 after interrupt clear + disable.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if status correctly reflects interrupt state; FAIL if bit not set or not cleared.
Notes: Read-only register; all 32 bits RO with reset value 0.

Test Case Description: Verify LSS sysreg interrupt enable register (intr_en1) correctly enables GPIO0 interrupt propagation to GIC. Write gpio0_intr bit (bit 1) to enable.
Register Description: LSS sysreg interrupt enable register 1. Bit 1 (gpio0_intr) enables GPIO0 block interrupt to propagate through sysreg to GIC. Bit 2 (gpio1_intr) for GPIO1.
Test Methodology: Write LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR to MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 to enable GPIO0 interrupt at sysreg level. This is a prerequisite for GPIO interrupts to reach the GIC.
Preconditions: System reset applied; GIC IRQ 87 enabled.
Test Steps:
1. write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR).
2. Trigger GPIO interrupt.
3. Verify interrupt reaches GIC (ISR entered).
Expected Result: GPIO0 interrupt propagates through sysreg to GIC when enabled.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if ISR is entered after enabling sysreg interrupt; FAIL if interrupt does not propagate.
Notes: Uses #ifdef GPIO0 conditional. For GPIO1 instance bit 2 (gpio1_intr) would be used instead.

Test Case Description: Verify LSS sysreg raw status/clear register (raw_stcr1) correctly reflects and clears GPIO0 interrupt status. Write gpio0_intr bit to clear; read back to verify cleared.
Register Description: LSS sysreg raw interrupt status/clear register 1. Bit 1 (gpio0_intr) shows raw interrupt status for GPIO0 block. Writing 1 to this bit clears the status.
Test Methodology: In ISR: write LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR to MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 to clear GPIO0 sysreg status. Then read back and verify gpio0_intr bit is 0.
Preconditions: GPIO interrupt has fired; ISR entered; per-pin interrupt already cleared.
Test Steps:
1. write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR).
2. rdata = read_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1).
3. Verify (rdata & LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR) == 0.
Expected Result: Sysreg GPIO0 interrupt status bit is cleared after write-1-to-clear.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if bit cleared; FAIL if status not cleared (test_err incremented).
Notes: RAWSTCR1 type: read returns latched raw status; write-1-to-clear. Uses #ifdef GPIO0 conditional.

Test Case Description: Verify per-pin interrupt clear mechanism. In ISR write 0x00110000 to GPIO register (sets intr_clr bit 16 = 1 to clear interrupt; keeps io_ctrl bit 20 = 1 for input mode). Read back and verify register value is 0x100001.
Register Description: Per-pin interrupt clear: writing 1 to intr_clr (bit 16) clears the interrupt raw status. After clear the expected read value is 0x100001 (io_ctrl=1 at bit 20 and data_in=1 at bit 0).
Test Methodology: In ISR: write 0x00110000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4). Wait 20 cycles. Read back and verify == 0x100001.
Preconditions: Interrupt has fired; ISR entered for pin i.
Test Steps:
1. write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) 0x00110000).
2. wait_on(20).
3. rdata = read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4)).
4. Verify rdata == 0x100001.
Expected Result: Register reads 0x100001 after interrupt clear (io_ctrl=1 at bit 20; data_in=1 at bit 0; all interrupt bits cleared).
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if rdata == 0x100001; FAIL otherwise (test_err incremented).
Notes: Write-only field intr_clr: writing 1 clears interrupt; reading always returns 0. Expected read 0x100001 = bit 20 (io_ctrl=1) + bit 0 (data_in=1).

Test Case Description: Verify external SRAM trigger mechanism at address 0xA0243ffc. This address is used to drive GPIO pin levels for interrupt testing. Write 0xFFFFFFFF for active-high; write ~(1<<i) for active-low.
Register Description: External SRAM location used as GPIO pin level driver for simulation/test. Writing values to this address controls the input levels seen by GPIO pins. Not a register in GPIO or LSS spec.
Test Methodology: Write to 0xA0243ffc to set GPIO pin input levels. For active-high: write 0xFFFFFFFF (all pins high). For active-low: write ~(1<<i) (specific pin low others high).
Preconditions: GPIO configured in input mode; interrupt enabled.
Test Steps:
1. write_reg(0xA0243ffc 0xFFFFFFFF) for active-high test.
2. write_reg(0xA0243ffc ~(1<<i)) for active-low test.
3. Verify interrupt fires for configured pin.
Expected Result: GPIO interrupt fires after SRAM write drives pin to configured interrupt level.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if interrupt fires after SRAM trigger; FAIL if no interrupt (timeout in int_pend loop).
Notes: Address 0xA0243ffc is unresolved in spec (not a GPIO/LSS register). It is an external SRAM location used for test stimulus.

Test Case Description: Verify that VRRW-type registers (gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 at offset 0x80 and group registers at offsets 0x94-0xC0) are correctly skipped during write-read testing via skip_array. These registers have VRRW field type where read/write size is variable and standard write-read patterns are not applicable.
Register Description: VRRW (Virtual Read-Read-Write) registers: read/write size not fixed. These are skipped in write-read test via skip_array[i]=1 and skip_rst_array[i]=1 to avoid false failures.
Test Methodology: Verify skip_array entries are set to 1 for VRRW register indices (index 32 37-48). Confirm these registers are not written or read during chk_rd_wr() and chk_rst_val() functions.
Preconditions: skip_array and skip_rst_array populated in test_define.c.
Test Steps:
1. Inspect skip_array: indices 32 37-48 have value 1.
2. Inspect skip_rst_array: indices 37-48 have value 1.
3. Run chk_rd_wr() and chk_rst_val().
4. Verify no write/read operations performed on VRRW registers.
Expected Result: VRRW registers are completely skipped; no false failures from variable-size register access.
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if VRRW registers are skipped and no errors logged for them; FAIL if any VRRW register is accessed.
Notes: VRRW type note from spec: 'Variable Read/Write: the size used for read or write might not be fixed'. skip_array[32]=1 skips gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 for wr/rd; skip_rst_array[37-48]=1 skips group registers for default check.
